constraints.name: stack_profile
constraints.why: rows run on one of the seven stack profiles (STACKS), which pairwise-cover the store and deployment factors

constraints.name: standalone_is_infra
constraints.why: a standalone MongoDB is what makes the path infrastructure_unavailable, and only it does

constraints.name: engine_needs_durable_agent
constraints.why: engine runs are durable runs of an engine agent, or of the default chat's Agent mode handing a job to the person's or the org's coding engine (ENGPICK)

constraints.name: engine_needs_broker
constraints.why: the worker plans no engine without the sandbox broker

constraints.name: engine_wire
constraints.why: opencode speaks chat completions, Codex Responses, Claude Code Messages through the model gateway

constraints.name: compiler_is_loop_only
constraints.why: the compiler runs only in the durable worker's loop kernel

constraints.name: memory_is_durable
constraints.why: governed memory is absent on the legacy route

constraints.name: memory_needs_a_person
constraints.why: a scheduled run is unattended and is granted no memory write scope (P7.3), so it is offered no remember tool

constraints.name: mode_tool_families
constraints.why: assistant modes and project chats expose only these tools

constraints.name: scheduled_runs
constraints.why: schedules fire durable agent runs (a firing the rollout says is legacy is refused) and send a fresh turn

constraints.name: helm_sandbox_modes
constraints.why: the chart offers broker mode (and local for values-local), not docker mode

constraints.name: decision_iff_prompt
constraints.why: a row has a user decision exactly when the oracle expects an approval card (see prompt_expected)

constraints.name: conversation_grant_offer
constraints.why: 'Allow for this conversation' is offered for a call that names its destination, held by the flow rule or an engine's default alone: an org's own write rule is never granted (QA10-F3)

constraints.name: child_model_needs_delegation
constraints.why: a role's model is read when a run spawns a child run, which only deep mode on a loop run does; an engine's helpers call the run's own model (MA1 §6)
